A short quest in {wiki:Tiquanda|Tiquanda}, east of Port Hope: cross the jungle to a {creature:Hydra}'s lair, get past it (or kill it) and take a {item:Hydra Egg} from the nest.
Defeat a hydra and enter its nest to pick up a Hydra Egg.
Stairs to the Hydra's lair (east of Tiquanda)
Enough health potions for the trip through the jungle and for the Hydra
You don't need to kill the Hydra: you can ignore it and go straight to the nest.
There may be more {creature:Hydra|Hydras} on the surface along the way.

Take a boat to **Port Hope** (for example, with {npc:Captain Bluebear} at Thais harbour: {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}). You arrive at the city harbour, next to {npc:Charles}, the captain who takes you back later.
Leave **Port Hope** and head to the **east of Tiquanda**, following the route on the map to the stairs.
Route from Port Hope to the Hydra's lair

On the way there are {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads}, {creature:Bandit|Bandits}, {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}, {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, {creature:Centipede|Centipedes}, {creature:Carniphila|Carniphilas}, {creature:Elephant|Elephants} and possibly {creature:Hydra|Hydras}.
Go down and get past the Hydra
Go down the stairs. Down there is **a single** {creature:Hydra}. Kill it or ignore it.
The Hydra hits hard and casts magical attacks. Below the recommended level, don't stay within its reach for long.
Use the {wiki:Hydra's Nest (Quest)|Hydra's Nest} in the **northeast** part of the room to receive the {item:Hydra Egg}.
The Hydra's nest, in the northeast of the room

To leave, climb up the **same stairs** you came down and follow the map route in reverse to **Port Hope**. At the harbour, talk to {npc:Charles} ({key:hi} and the name of the city you want to go to, then {key:yes}) to go back.
On the way back you meet the same creatures as on the way there: keep potions for the trip.
